name: A student's own course files
goodFor: The most relevant source there is: what the student's own course teaches.
notes: Not a published source, so there's no licence page to check. Used on the student's device, for that student alone. Never stored in this repository, and never shared between students. A file can carry terms of its own: OpenStax books, for one, now say they may not be ingested into generative AI offerings without OpenStax's permission (see openstax).
